description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

The Assistant Director of Nursing will support the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. This position is ideal for an experienced Registered Nurse looking to advance their career in a supportive and dynamic environment. If you are passionate about quality care and leadership, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Prior experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills

description:
We are urgently seeking two dedicated Full-time AM Registered Nurses to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in St. Petersburg, FL. This role involves 12-hour shifts, from 7 AM to 7 PM, providing essential care to residents in a supportive environment. This is an excellent opportunity for nurses looking to make an immediate impact.

Our facility is a 55-59 bed center, currently serving a census of 43 residents. Located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building, it offers a convenient and appealing setting. Plus, you're just 15 minutes from the beautiful St. Petersburg beaches, and the facility features two inviting courtyards.

We offer a competitive hourly rate of $30.00 - $35.00, with an additional $2.00 shift differential for AM shifts, reflecting our commitment to valuing our nursing staff.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Florida.
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment preferred.
Ability to work 12-hour AM shifts (7 AM - 7 PM).
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $30.00 - $35.00 with an additional $2.00 shift differential for AM shifts.
